title: A life unraveled, Kennedy Center chaos, new dating apps: Catch up on the day’s stories | CNN
text:
👋Welcome to 5 Things PM!Many Americans are feeling financially squeezed as prices for groceries, gas and other essentials remain stubbornly high. Even so, the median US household income justclimbed to a record level.

Here’s what else you might have missed during your busy day.

Ivanna Ortiz was a different person before a car accident and bitter custody battle, friends and relatives say. Now she stands accused oftrying to kill Rihannaby firing at least 10 shots from an AR-15 rifle at the singer’s Los Angeles home.

The Kennedy Center boardvoted to close the performing arts venuefor renovations after a tense meeting in which President Donald Trump called in to berate a Democratic congresswoman who serves on the panel, sources said.

➕ Supreme Court:Trump unloads on conservative justices

CNN’s Jake Tapper goes fly fishing with California Gov. Gavin Newsom in Montana, where they talk family, regrets and whether Newsom will run for president.Watch the full interview.

▶️ ‘It’s darker now’:Newsom describes his relationship with Trump

In an era when many men struggle with social isolation, an annual fantasy football draftmight be the next best thing. Some of these guys have been at it for 35 years.

Some new sites are ditching the endless swiping and encouraging potential matches to meet up in the real world andshare experiences together.

🚔 Wild chase:Authorities in Dayton, Ohio, said a suspect abandoned his SUV during a pursuit and stole a police cruiser, then sped through a residential neighborhood andcrashed into a house.

🐯 Lost species:The Tasmanian tiger, which went extinct almost a century ago, hada huge skull and a lethal snap— a rare combination for a carnivorous mammal.

EDITOR’S NOTE:Interested in exclusive stories like these?Choose a plan

📺 Which show won the Emmy Award for outstanding comedy series?

A. “Hacks”

B. “The Bear”

C. “Widow’s Bay”

D. “Abbott Elementary”

⬇️Scroll down for the answer.

✅Most popular in yesterday’s newsletter:El Niño just leveled up to super status. Here’s what that means for the weather

🧠Quiz answer: C.“Widow’s Bay” dominated the awardsby taking home six statues, including Matthew Rhys for lead actor in a comedy series.

👋 We’ll see you tomorrow.

Today’s edition of 5 Things PM was edited and produced by CNN’s Kimberly Richardson and Meghan Pryce.
